description: This file defines a class 'SiloMetadataCache' responsible for caching and managing metadata of silos in a distributed Orleans cluster. It subscribes to lifecycle events, processes membership updates, maintains cache consistency, and handles concurrent access to silo metadata.

classes.name: SiloMetadataCache
classes.description: Handles caching and updating silo metadata, subscribing to lifecycle and membership events, and managing the cache lifecycle.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the cache to the lifecycle to start and stop processing membership updates.

methods.name: ProcessMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Continuously processes membership updates from the membership table and updates the cache accordingly.

methods.name: GetSiloMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves cached metadata for a specified silo address.

methods.name: SetMetadata
methods.description: Adds or updates metadata for a specified silo address.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cancels the internal cancellation token to stop processing updates.
